objective: Implement R60 PC-only low-resolution icon AI upscaling with dynamic ONNX loading and safe canvas fallback
acceptance_criteria: Detect images with width or height below 256px and expose the Korean PC-only AI upscale toggle with default ON on supported desktop browsers.
Load onnxruntime-web and the Waifu2x ONNX model only through dynamic import from the isolated upscaler module; do not add the runtime to the initial mobile bundle.
Fallback immediately to resizeImageToWebP on mobile, unavailable WebGL/WASM, model load failure, or inference failure.
Integrate the async result and loading state into existing admin icon and schedule request upload flows without changing existing upload behavior.

Add unit/component tests for low-resolution detection, desktop default-on behavior, mobile/unsupported/failure fallback, dynamic import boundary, and loading/error states; pass tsc, lint, Vitest, and diff-check.
Update docs/to-do.md with verified implementation status after completion; do not change database schema.
